title: the-ground-loop-pane-shows-its-state
intention: The ground loop's device page displays its state from the liveness record — last run, state, and pid — as a declared pane.
why: A read-projection of the record, not a second source. The pane computes nothing about liveness; it renders what the loop wrote. Every surface is a view (the bus/one-web-server rule).

falsifier.proves_red: The pane displays a liveness the record does not say — i.e. it derives or caches rather than renders. And: the pane must be honest when the record is STALE or ABSENT, showing 'not running' or 'unknown' rather than blank or a last-known-good.
